name: ai-sdlc
description: A staged, artifact-driven AI software development lifecycle: intent → specs → design → plan → review → build → verify.

template_mode.title: Template mode
template_mode.description: guide: use each stage's template as a starting point, keeping IDs, headers, and traceability. strict: follow each template's structure exactly.

guardrails.title: Guardrail hooks
guardrails.description: Opt-in hooks that ask before a stage document is marked Approved, ask before a build task edits a file its plan task does not list, and block test edits while a bug fix has its tests locked.
